title_en: Israeli demolition in East Jerusalem displaces 69 Palestinians

title_en: ‘Nothing can justify these atrocities,’ says Guterres three years on from 7 October attacks

title_en: Gaza: WHO appeals for massive aid influx ahead of winter

excerpt_en: The UN is continuing efforts to support Palestinians in Gaza amid major challenges to humanitarian access, reconstruction and the restoration of essential services, according to Ramiz Alakbarov, Acting UN Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process.

excerpt_en: UN teams are racing to protect families in Gaza from the coming rainy season, but restricted access to land and shortages of critical supplies are hampering the effort, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Wednesday.

In the West Bank, settler violence and settlement expansion are raising fears for a two-State solution. In Gaza, a year-old peace plan has stalled while civilian suffering continues.
